author: G. K. Chesterton
name: The Outline of Sanity
desc: Chesterton's exposition of distributism: some general ideas, some aspects of big business, of the land and of machinery, a note on emigration, and a summary. A plea for the widest possible distribution of property against both capitalism and socialism, from the Catholic social tradition.
desc_pt: A exposição de Chesterton do distributismo: algumas ideias gerais, alguns aspectos da grande empresa, da terra e da maquinaria, uma nota sobre a emigração e um resumo. Um apelo à mais ampla distribuição possível da propriedade contra o capitalismo e o socialismo, na tradição social católica.
edition: The Outline of Sanity (London: Methuen, 1926), Internet Archive full-text OCR (theoutlineofsanity).
manual: II. Some Aspects of Big Business
III. Some Aspects of the Land
srcnote: Six parts as printed; the numbered subsections inside each part are not marked off.
tierEvidence: Chesterton died in 1936 and the book was published in 1926, so it is public domain.
